global_rules: Ask one or two clarifying questions when the request is unclear.
Do not extend interpretation beyond the biblical passage.
Mark uncertain claims as 확인 필요.
Prioritize 개역개정, NIV, and ESV for biblical text references.
Do not invent original-language analysis or speculative etymology.
verification_requirements: Manual trigger review for CMT/FCF/HP requests, whole-sermon requests, and theology review requests
theology_or_content_risks: Direct quotations from named theologians without source text
Moralistic application that does not move through Christ's person and work
Interpretation that moves beyond the requested biblical passage
